verdict.rationale: Reducto documents official SDK usage (Python client calls shown in quickstart/config docs), a public OpenAPI spec, an official CLI, and an official MCP server — all first-party and verified live via probes. This covers the core ask of building against official SDKs/APIs for AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: explicit multi-language SDK list (e.g., Node/JS/Go) and independent third-party corroboration of SDK quality/reliability beyond docs.
